title: Learning to Reason with Selective Internal Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.21392v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning from internal feedback can improve language models without ground-truth answers or external verifiers. However, confidence and correctness can diverge during training, and continued optimization of average self-certainty can increase confidence while degrading reasoning accuracy. We introduce SIF, a reinforcement learning method that combines comparative reward construction with selective policy updates. SIF compares ranked token-level self-certainty profiles across multiple windows and peers, assigning positive rewards only when both levels of voting provide sufficient support. Sample and group level filtering determines which responses contribute to policy optimization. Experiments on three backbones across 12 mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks show that SIF's final checkpoints achieve higher average accuracy than the best-validation checkpoints of Intuitor and Vigor, with a gain of 4.71 percentage

translated_title: 基于选择性内部反馈的推理学习
translated_abstract: 来自内部反馈的强化学习可以在没有真实答案或外部验证器的情况下改进语言模型。然而，在训练过程中，置信度与正确性可能出现分歧，持续优化平均自我确定性可能会在提高置信度的同时降低推理准确率。我们提出SIF，这是一种将比较式奖励构建与选择性策略更新相结合的强化学习方法。SIF在多个窗口和多个对等模型之间比较排序后的词元级自我确定性分布，只有当两个层级的投票都提供足够支持时才给予正奖励。样本级和组级过滤决定哪些响应参与策略优化。在三个骨干模型上跨12个数学与科学推理基准的实验表明，SIF的最终检查点比Intuitor和Vigor的最佳验证检查点取得了更高的平均准确率，提升了4.71个百分点。
tldr: SIF是一种强化学习方法，通过在多个窗口和对等模型间比较词元级自我确定性并进行双层投票来构建奖励，并结合样本级与组级选择性过滤更新策略，从而在无需真实答案或外部验证器的情况下提升语言模型推理能力，在12个数学与科学推理基准上比Intuitor和Vigor高出4.71个百分点。
en_tdlr: SIF is a reinforcement learning method that builds rewards through dual-level voting over ranked token-level self-certainty compared across multiple windows and peers, combined with selective sample- and group-level policy updates, improving LLM reasoning accuracy by 4.71 percentage points over Intuitor and Vigor on 12 math and science benchmarks without ground-truth answers or external verifiers.
